findings.message: Params busca and page have effect filter:pessoasEquipe and are persisted, but no state holds them. Added public states busca (string | null) and page (number | null), both persisted, and they take part in the input of listarMembrosEquipe.

selectedMembroEquipe (select:cadastroPessoa) had no member that writes it. Added selectCadastroPessoa(id | null), which publishes the id and calls obterMembroEquipe (which has the id as input); null clears membro and the edit draft.

Commands cadastrarPessoa and salvarAlteracoesPessoa are submitted from the form cadastroPessoa but no state has their input as source. Added cadastrarPessoaDraft and salvarAlteracoesPessoaDraft with setters setCadastrarPessoaDraft and setSalvarAlteracoesPessoaDraft; the edit draft is filled from membro (loaded or returned by the commands).

The route returns membro for cadastrarPessoa and salvarAlteracoesPessoa with no state as source; applied it to the list membros (upsert by id; a new person is appended since the order by name cannot be computed in the browser), to membro, selectedMembroEquipe and the edit draft. The server order of the list may differ until it is reloaded.
